description: Extracts individual entities from a large source document and creates separate .md files for each one. Use when a source contains multiple distinct entities that should each have their own file, or when user says "extract", "pull out entities", "split this file", or "create files from this source". Does NOT compile scattered info about one entity — use /compiling-entities for that.
